attacks.name: Adaptive Energy Blast
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attacks' type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |*Countermeasures|: After this attack is resolved, if its attack's type is |!energy|, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition. Otherwise, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

attacks.name: Shockweb
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Total Annihilation
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Degeneration|: After this attack is resolved, the defender cannot have |!damage| removed from it until the end of the |*Activation Phase| this Round.

superPowers.name: Magnetokinesis
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Teleportation Matrix
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Metahuman Power Recognition and Adaptation Protocol
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll. Add 1 additional die to this character's defense roll for each other time it has used |*Metahuman Power Recognition and Adaptation Protocol| this Turn.

superPowers.name: Enhanced Sentinel Power Core
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.|\|Additionally, this character cannot be Advanced or Pushed by |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.
